method.classification: existing means the behavior is observable in the reviewed checkout and tests; gap means a new frozen contract and implementation is required; human_or_real_data means engineering can prepare the interface but cannot close the product gate with fixtures.

method.source_checkout_dirty_reason: The source-conversion checkout contains the separately reviewed conversion WIP and probe material. The domain/product observations below are anchored to its baseline commit/tree and do not treat those WIP files as accepted implementation.

remaining_surfaces.objective: Typed knowledge relations, structured comparison, graph and retrieval fusion
dependencies: SOURCE: accepted capture/semantics/publication plus conversion and source-catalog completion
CODE: official repository/commit/config evidence and mapping contract
existing_scope: Use existing claim/evidence/assessment/source-version identities and the light comparison/query behavior as inputs.
Do not replace light_query.v1, legacy retrieval config/gold, or closed source v1 schemas.

gaps.missing: Immutable domain/comparison profile bytes and a transaction-published profile-head. The profile must freeze axes, typed value/condition fields, predicate registry, comparability rules and version/hash identity; the caller cannot choose a different profile at query time.

Canonical annotation and review-event schemas binding claim_id, source/version locator, profile_sha256, evidence fingerprint, proposed type and terminal review status. Accepted typed facts require both annotation review and claim assessment accepted with all referenced source/profile/head material current.

Typed experiment conditions covering task, dataset/split, resolution/frame count, metric/unit, protocol, implementation/config and source version. Missing or conflicting conditions must remain unknown/not_comparable; values must never be inferred from a prose cell.

Directed typed support/contradiction/implements/baseline/depends-on/compares relations with endpoint kind checks, locator/evidence bindings and candidate-versus-supported semantics. Co-occurrence/similarity cannot create a fact edge.

Deterministic graph generation and query projection including complete input inventory, profile/head, claim/assessment/evidence paths, source-version paths, generation hash and rebuild-from-canonical-input behavior. Orphan, stale, mixed-profile and changed-head inputs must refuse or become non-current.

A research retrieval result that keeps exact, BM25 and typed-graph ranks separate, applies deterministic RRF, then filters by evidence state/freshness/independence and emits bounded included/omitted context with all locator/version hashes. Legacy/light RRF remains unchanged.

Paper↔repository↔commit↔file/config capability relations that distinguish official implementation, baseline, dependency and third-party reproduction; URL or a linked repo alone cannot promote officiality.

contract_to_freeze.write_boundary: Research can propose annotations/comparisons and consume read-only generations. Engine/operator transaction is the only path that publishes profile/head/annotation/relation/generation.

acceptance_cases.action: Submit an annotation with a missing locator, an unaccepted claim assessment, a foreign profile hash and a relation whose endpoint type is invalid.
acceptance_cases.expected: Each refusal has a stable typed code, no canonical file/head/index mutation occurs, and the failure still checks the complete staged input set.

acceptance_cases.action: Publish one profile/head, two accepted claims and a supported relation, then build the graph twice from the same canonical snapshot.
acceptance_cases.expected: The generation/projection bytes and query order are byte-identical; every supported row exposes profile/head, claim, source-version and locator hashes.

acceptance_cases.action: Compare equal metrics under different dataset/split/resolution/protocol and compare a row with omitted conditions.
acceptance_cases.expected: The first is not_comparable with a typed condition mismatch; the second is unknown/not_comparable. No numeric ranking or guessed value is emitted.

acceptance_cases.action: Delete graph/BM25 caches, rebuild, and inject an orphan relation, stale source-version, mixed profile or changed profile-head during query.
acceptance_cases.expected: Clean deletion rebuilds from canonical truth; every invalid injection refuses or returns non-current with a reason and never produces a current answer.

acceptance_cases.action: Provide separate exact/BM25/graph rank lists with ties, duplicate entities and a missing optional dense route.
acceptance_cases.expected: RRF uses only declared rank positions, tie order is stable, paper versions are deduplicated as specified, and missing dense input does not disable the base path.

acceptance_cases.action: Bind a comparison or answer citation to a historical source association after the display head rolls back.
acceptance_cases.expected: The citation remains valid when its exact association/raw bytes/locator remain valid; display selection and citation association are reported separately.

acceptance_cases.action: Run the first technical-axis slice with three real papers and one confirmed official repository.
acceptance_cases.expected: A domain reviewer can inspect conditions, typed annotations, support/contradiction candidates and code mappings back to real source locators; fixture success alone cannot close this gate.

real_gates: HUMAN-CLAIM-ASSESSMENT-001 for accepted claims and typed domain review
EXTERNAL-PROVENANCE-LICENSE-001 for retained real paper/code evidence

remaining_surfaces.objective: Cited full articles and source-bound reproduction plans
dependencies: DOMAIN accepted profile/annotation/relation/generation and typed context-pack
CODE accepted official/third-party mapping and commit/config evidence
existing_scope: light_compare supports a bounded model-proposed matrix with conditions and citations.
writing.py and light_writing_project.py support cited Markdown drafts, section edits, history and create-only workspace export.

gaps.missing: Formal article/comparison artifact with immutable source/context/profile/generation bindings, paragraph and table-cell factual-unit IDs, bibliography rows and exact source-version/PDF-or-artifact hash/locator references.

Support-review records for every factual unit. Core claims must be supported by accepted evidence; partially_supported, unsupported, contradicted and not_assessable remain visible and cannot silently pass as unknown.

Source-bound reproduction plan describing code relation, exact commit, files/configs, dataset/split, environment/dependency requirements, commands, expected outputs, known deviations and blocked/unknown items. Missing evidence is explicit, never invented.

Create-only formal namespace (wiki/synthesis/generated/<artifact-id>.md or equivalent) through transaction, receipt, audit and backup. Revisions create a new artifact ID with supersedes; user notes remain outside compiler ownership.
Formal draft/reviewed/published/superseded/stale state derivation and comparison of current generation/profile/source heads; a Markdown file alone must not imply publication or scientific acceptance.

contract_to_freeze.binding: Every report/article/reproduction factual unit must resolve to source version, artifact hash and locator or an explicit unknown/blocked reason.

acceptance_cases.action: Import a two-paper comparison with citations, conditions and one not_comparable row.
acceptance_cases.expected: Every cell/row has exact paper/source-version/locator identity, conditions are rendered, not_comparable has a reason, and foreign/missing citations refuse before output creation.

acceptance_cases.action: Change a source version, profile head or context generation after exporting an article draft.
acceptance_cases.expected: The old draft stays immutable/history-only; current publication is refused or marked stale and a new draft references the changed inputs.

acceptance_cases.action: Submit an article whose factual units include one unsupported, one contradicted and one unassessable unit.
acceptance_cases.expected: Support review labels each unit independently, core publication cannot pass, and the unresolved reasons remain in the artifact.

acceptance_cases.action: Create a reproduction plan for a repository lacking an official mapping, exact commit or configuration.
acceptance_cases.expected: The plan is blocked/unknown with missing-evidence fields; it never claims official implementation or a reproducible command set.

acceptance_cases.action: Publish a reviewed generated article, attempt overwrite, then create a successor revision.
acceptance_cases.expected: The first bytes remain immutable, overwrite is rejected, successor has a new ID/supersedes edge, and receipt/audit/backup include the new namespace.

acceptance_cases.action: Have a designated domain reviewer inspect the first real comparison/article/reproduction plan and a real Obsidian rendering.
acceptance_cases.expected: Reviewer decisions, disputed units and visual observations are recorded separately from engineering tests; no model self-review is counted as approval.

remaining_surfaces.objective: Corpus, independent gold interfaces, model runs and semantic evaluation
dependencies: SOURCE stable source/version inventory and locators
existing_scope: retrieval.py provides closed config/gold/mapping validation and four legacy tracks with deterministic metrics.
qa.py/light_qa.py check citation identity and locator structure; these are not semantic factual-support adjudication.
Existing light tests cover malformed boundaries, stale contexts, unknown cells and citation mismatches.

gaps.missing: Versioned corpus manifest with eligible papers/source versions, evidence-unit inventory, representation layer, candidate universe, hard negatives, source/license provenance and exact hashes. Metadata-only seed rows cannot enter full-text quality denominators.

Independent gold manifest for answerability, expected intent/entity/filter, required-point IDs, accepted evidence, contradiction/uncertainty labels, source-independence and rubric. Gold freeze event and lineage must precede qualification dispatch.

Factual-unit decomposition and point scoring: per-point supported coverage, required limitations/units/versions/conditions, duplicate handling, unanswerable refusal and dispute/open status. Model-generated gold cannot adjudicate itself.

Model qualification run/attempt manifest with fixed corpus/context/prompt/runtime/decoding config, three independent complete rounds, failures/cancellations and reviewer/score references. No cherry-picking a best run.

Versioned evidence-unit Recall@10 and retrieval metrics with declared minimum corpus/distractor counts; answerable coverage/support gates; comparison/article/reproduction diagnostics; not_evaluable when data cannot support a metric.
Real-paper and real-model trials plus independent semantic review. Fixture/local tests cannot be relabelled as genuine source/model acceptance.

minimums: W5a at least 10 answerable and 3 unanswerable questions
W5b1 at least 6 comparison questions including 2 expected not_comparable
full paper Recall@5 requires at least 30 eligible candidates
evidence-unit Recall@10 requires at least 20 real non-gold units across at least 3 papers and at least 5 reviewed hard negatives
gates: answerable required-point coverage >=80% each and >=90% overall
every factual unit supported with parseable citation coverage 100% and zero dangling citations
three-round gate uses the minimum round result and preserves all attempts

acceptance_cases.action: Load corpus/gold/rubric/run files with a changed source hash, duplicate point ID, unknown candidate, missing lineage or mismatched profile/current head.
acceptance_cases.expected: Validation refuses before scoring with a typed reason; it never trusts caller-provided assessment or silently drops rows.

acceptance_cases.action: Evaluate a small corpus with fewer than the declared candidate/distractor minimums and an unreviewed potential negative.
acceptance_cases.expected: The result is not_evaluable with the deficiency recorded; no invented placeholder negative or full-benchmark pass is emitted.

acceptance_cases.action: Score an answerable response with all unknowns, an unsupported number, omitted unit/version and one dangling citation.
acceptance_cases.expected: Required-point coverage and support fail; unknown is not a substitute for a supported answer and dangling citations are zero-tolerance.

acceptance_cases.action: Run three distinct qualification attempts, one infrastructure-failed and one semantically failed, then change the prompt.
acceptance_cases.expected: Every attempt remains in history; the changed prompt is a new attempt; gate evaluation uses all three complete rounds and the minimum, never a selected best answer.

acceptance_cases.action: Mutate an input source/profile/index between run dispatch and score.
acceptance_cases.expected: The run is stale/invalid and cannot be scored as current; the exact snapshot and reason are preserved.

acceptance_cases.action: Freeze a gold set before the first qualification dispatch, obtain designated semantic review, and execute the first real three-round paper/model trial.
acceptance_cases.expected: Reviewer identity/event, disputes and accepted points are real and traceable; local fixture pass remains a separate engineering result.

real_gates: real model/runtime and real source trial evidence

remaining_surfaces.objective: Obsidian views, status and all-namespace backup/restore integration
dependencies: SYNTHESIS published namespace and support status
existing_scope: Light paper list/edit/archive/restore/replace/recover journals preserve notes and expose stale index/reindex actions.
Light workflow prepare/status/complete and workspace inspect expose resumable model handoffs and pending state.
Light backup verifies/restores its own workspace; formal backup/restore verifies a receipt-backed .raw/wiki Vault and current catalog/report.
domain_cli exposes seed/index/query/catalog-report/audit/retrieval/backup entrypoints; research CLI exposes light library/knowledge/compare/writing/backup entrypoints.

gaps.missing: One read-only status/diagnostic contract that derives source ingest/version/display-head, catalog/index, domain profile/graph, synthesis artifact, quality run and recovery states with current/stale/conflict/unknown/coverage gaps. It must preserve fatal stale codes and provide next operator action.

Version-aware formal maintenance for source association/display-head changes, claim/annotation/relation invalidation, downstream generation staleness and rollback-as-new-decision. Light paper replacement alone cannot supply this.

Deterministic Paper/Code/Concept/domain/comparison/article/reproduction/quality views or Bases with links to current and historical source/version/claim/assessment/profile/generation status. Compiler must not overwrite user notes; visual readability requires a real Vault review.

A cross-namespace backup manifest/checkpoint covering formal Vault, source/domain/synthesis/quality namespaces, light workspace, .work/research sessions, receipts, heads, immutable histories and required raw/extra outputs, with one retained snapshot and exact hashes.

Isolated restore that validates complete-set inventory, source anchor, operation heads, all namespace pointers, catalog/graph/context generations, session bytes and no alias/overlap with the source. Missing optional external anchor must remain visible.
Natural-language/operator handoff for status, maintenance, backup, isolated restore and recovery; the agent prepares/inspects but does not call vpwiki-admin or mutate a real Vault.

contract_to_freeze.ownership: Engine owns canonical namespaces and transaction/receipt/audit; research owns disposable sessions/context/runs; user notes remain user-owned. The cross-namespace manifest references both scopes without creating a second fact source.

acceptance_cases.action: Ask status on an empty workspace, a stale light index, a changed source-version, a mixed domain generation and a pending writing/batch/library operation.
acceptance_cases.expected: A deterministic read-only envelope reports each state, reason and next action; it does not create directories, rebuild indexes or downgrade stale/fatal errors.

acceptance_cases.action: Replace or roll back a formal source display association while a historical citation and typed graph generation refer to another retained association.
acceptance_cases.expected: Stable paper/claim IDs and history remain, citation validity is evaluated by its exact association, dependent projections become stale/current only after rebuild, and rollback is a new decision.

acceptance_cases.action: Build Obsidian views twice from identical canonical inputs and with pre-existing user notes.
acceptance_cases.expected: Generated bytes are deterministic and create-only; user notes are unchanged; all links/status badges resolve to exact current/history identities.

acceptance_cases.action: Create a complete cross-namespace backup, restore it to a fresh private directory, then remove/corrupt one namespace file, add an unexpected file, alias roots or change a head during verification.
acceptance_cases.expected: The intact restore passes exact inventory and semantic checks; every incomplete/unsafe case refuses with a missing/extra/alias/race reason and preserves the source.

acceptance_cases.action: Interrupt a cross-namespace backup/restore or status handoff after staging and resume it.
acceptance_cases.expected: Owned staging is safely reconciled, unknown user bytes are preserved, checkpoint/head history is not rewritten, and repeat execution is idempotent or explicitly conflict-closed.

acceptance_cases.action: Run the final seven-slice flow in an isolated real Vault and record backup external anchor plus restore observation.
acceptance_cases.expected: Obsidian visual review, operator action count, external raw-inclusive anchor and isolated restore evidence are separately recorded; fixture ZIP success is not production readiness.

real_gates: real operator application and isolated restore

dependency_groups.name: source-and-code-authority
requires: finish SOURCE conversion boundary repair and source-catalog contract/implementation
dependency_groups.reason: Typed facts and formal citations need current source-version/association/locator bytes and trustworthy paper-code relations.

dependency_groups.name: quality
deliverables: real trial and independent review handoff

cross_cutting_rules: Treat canonical source/claim/assessment/profile/head/relation bytes as the only fact authority; Markdown/catalog/BM25/graph/context packs and reports are rebuildable projections.
Keep all old closed v1 schemas, light schemas, legacy retrieval behavior, 67 seed entries and user-note ownership unchanged unless a successor contract explicitly names a compatibility adapter.
Every current result binds a complete source/profile/generation/head set and exact hashes; stale, mixed, uncovered, not_comparable and unknown are first-class outcomes.
No model-generated proposal, comparison, answer, article or gold can self-approve semantic truth; independent review events and unresolved disputes remain visible.

Do not use fixture bytes, local tests, synthetic summaries or a test receipt as evidence of real source provenance, operator application, Obsidian visual quality, model qualification or external backup anchoring.
Python CLI remains zero-egress and agent-safe; online/real Vault/operator steps are explicit handoffs and cannot be silently simulated.

human_and_external_gates.needed_for: accepted claims, typed annotations, article factual support
raw-inclusive external backup anchor and isolated restore
user merge/readiness decision after exact-head CI

recommended_sequence: Close/freeze SOURCE conversion and source-catalog plus CODE mapping first; preserve all prior rejected evidence and legacy behavior.
Freeze DOMAIN engine profile/annotation/relation/condition and graph generation before adding research retrieval fusion.
Build formal SYNTHESIS contracts/publication on top of typed context and source-bound code evidence; retain light_compare/writing as draft conveniences.
Freeze QUALITY corpus/gold/rubric/run before looking at qualification outputs; run engineering checks, then separate real model/source trials and independent review.
Integrate PRODUCT status/maintenance/views and cross-namespace backup/restore only after each producer exposes its namespace/checkpoint; run final isolated recovery and human gates.
completion_boundary: The reviewed checkout already supports useful lightweight research use, but cannot claim the full-todo DOMAIN/SYNTHESIS/QUALITY/PRODUCT objectives. The gaps above require new contracts and implementation; real-data and human gates remain open.
